assessments.name: Written and creative response
assessments.description: Assessment task 1 invites students to map their chosen field of educational research using creative and written methods. Students will be asked to explain their map and its relationships, potentially drawing on methodology, theory, research questions.

assessments.name: Written response
assessments.description: Students will write a response to demonstrate their understanding of the changes in thinking about social research and critically reflect on these changes, as well as hypothesise about future developments
